title: Open-base comparison for every normalized symmetric Proj quotient
statement: For a scheme S, an arbitrary quasi-coherent O_S-module E, and any normalized TautologicalQuotient D on Proj_S Sym(E) [def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data], HasOpenCompatibility D holds. Explicitly, for each open V of S, the pulled module E_V is quasi-coherent; there is a normalized quotient DV on Proj_V Sym(E_V), a map j to Proj_S Sym(E) giving the pullback square over V -> S, and an isomorphism j*D.line -> DV.line preserving the pulled quotient via the canonical pullback-composition comparisons. V is arbitrary, including empty and nonaffine opens.

proof.text: For arbitrary open V, tensorOrdinaryPullbackIso transports quasi-coherence of ordinary pullback to tensor pullback. Apply normalized descent to E_V to obtain DV; only its quotient-existence clause is needed here.

Apply exists_normalized_pullbackData to V.ι and E. Its explicit generator maps, degreewise affine base-change bijections and restriction naturality give b. Use b.relProjComparison for j and the proved b.isPullback for its square.

Apply the fixed-comparison quotient-line theorem to D, DV, b and its generator equation, using the module-equality proof already fixed in HasOpenCompatibility. Its w and exact quotient equation, together with the witnesses above, inhabit HasOpenCompatibility D, including empty and nonaffine V.
